Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 27-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Cloud Computing [NPT_4120]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Analyse how the NIST definition of cloud computing reflects its five essential characteristics.        (5)  
  Explain how these characteristics collectively differentiate cloud computing from traditional IT  
  A)           infrastructure.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Differentiate between public, private, hybrid, and community cloud deployment models by analysing (3)  
  their suitability for different types of organizations.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Illustrate with suitable examples how IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS are used in practical cloud computing       (2)  
  environments.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                Evaluate the importance of measurable SLA metrics in maintaining accountability between cloud          (5)  
  service providers and customers.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Assess how different pricing models influence the budgeting and scalability strategies of cloud-       (3)  
  based organizations.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Demonstrate how automation tools can help overcome performance and audit challenges in multi-          (2)  
  tenant cloud environments.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Evaluate the role of automation in maintaining accuracy and compliance across all stages of the        (5)  
  cloud data lifecycle.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Explain how organizations use data governance policies to meet industry-specific compliance            (3)  
  standards in cloud computing.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  Page #1

C)               Describe how object storage simplifies data retrieval and scalability in large-scale cloud              (2)  
  environments.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                       Discuss how predictive analytics can be applied for proactive resource allocation in cloud              (5)  
  environments.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)               Evaluate how adaptive load balancing strategies maintain optimal performance during traffic spikes (3)  
  in cloud systems.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)               Explain how energy-efficient virtualization techniques contribute to sustainable cloud data center      (2)  
  operations.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                       Investigate the impact of shared responsibility models on addressing security challenges in cloud       (5)  
  environments.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)               Apply encryption and key management techniques to secure data transmission between cloud                (3)  
  clients and servers.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)               Evaluate the role of IAM in enforcing least-privilege access and preventing insider threats in cloud    (2)  
  systems.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  
  -----End-----
